boards.note: Create a board from plan.json only if it does not exist yet (White Elephant Gift Ideas). At most one new board per week.

rules: One pin per day. Never post the same destination link twice within 7 days.
Each pin gets a fresh image (new headline, angle or layout), never a re-upload of an old pin image.

Product pins link straight to Amazon with the affiliate tag and carry the disclosure. Use Amazon's own main product photo (the image URL from the product page, posted the way Amazon's Share button does). Only pin products whose Amazon page shows an Add to Cart or Buy Now button and is not down to its last few units.
Photo layout designs only for Lindsay's own designs (her Etsy listing photos).
Never use em dashes in any text.
